quantities: SELECT P.CVE_ART,COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(P.UNI_VENTA),''),'Unidad') UNIT,SUM(P.CANT) QUANTITY,COUNT(DISTINCT P.CVE_DOC) INVOICES FROM PAR_FACTF15 P JOIN FACTF15 F ON F.CVE_DOC=P.CVE_DOC WHERE F.STATUS<>'C' AND TRIM(F.CVE_CLPV)='520' AND COALESCE(F.FECHAELAB,F.FECHA_DOC)>='2026-09-07' AND COALESCE(F.FECHAELAB,F.FECHA_DOC)<'2026-10-07' AND COALESCE(P.TIPO_PROD,'')<>'K' GROUP BY P.CVE_ART,P.UNI_VENTA
units: SELECT P.CVE_ART,P.UNI_VENTA,P.CANT,P.PREC,P.DESCR_ART, F.CVE_DOC, F.FECHAELAB FROM PAR_FACTF15 P JOIN FACTF15 F ON F.CVE_DOC=P.CVE_DOC WHERE F.CVE_DOC='F-EQ000082' ORDER BY P.NUM_PAR
